title: Strengthening Governance of Madrasahs in light of Developments Relating to Recent Police Report Made by Madrasah Irsyad
what_it_is: Strengthening Governance of Madrasahs in light of Developments Relating to Recent Police Report Made by Madrasah Irsyad

sections.label: Madrasah audit and $2 million transfer
sections.summary: A 2016 audit found $2 million transferred from the madrasah to ITL in 2014 with MMC endorsement but without BOG approval; MUIS sought its return and filed a Police report.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: For example, the annual audit of the madrasah's accounts in 2016 found that $2 million had been transferred from the madrasah to ITL in 2014 for its international operations, with the endorsement of the MMC, but without the knowledge or approval of the BOG.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Following this discovery, MUIS requested ITL to return this $2 million sum to the madrasah, which ITL did so in full.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Based on preliminary findings from this audit, MUIS lodged a Police report in July 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Earlier this month, the madrasah filed a civil claim against a Director in ITL and other related parties, to seek an account of their improper use of the madrasah's funds and resources for ITL's purposes and to recover losses caused to the madrasah.

sections.label: External audits and MUIS Police report
sections.summary: Discoveries including the $2 million transfer came from external audits, and a 2021 special review led MUIS to file a Police report.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: A lot of these can come from the internal reporting, but these few discoveries that we have mentioned, including the $2 million transfer, came after we undertook an audit externally, into the madrasah as part of the process of ensuring governance and checks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For example, discovery of the $2 million transfer was done after an audit in 2016, although it was transacted in 2014 internally by the MMC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In the same way, too, MUIS commissioned a special review in 2021 – which is way past the 2016 timeline – to see whether there are even further transactions between the madrasah and ITL.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It is in 2021, arising from the findings of this review, that MUIS filed a Police report.
